import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Revenue by product (horizontal bar chart)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
product_revenue.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax1.set_title('Revenue by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Sales quantity by size (pie chart)
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
size_quantity = df.groupby('size')['quantity'].sum()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(size_quantity)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(size_quantity.values, labels=size_quantity.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 3. Average transaction value by age group (bar chart)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
age_group_avg = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].mean().sort_index()
bars = ax3.bar(range(len(age_group_avg)), age_group_avg.values, 
               color=plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0, 1, len(age_group_avg))))
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(age_group_avg)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(age_group_avg.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)')
ax3.set_title('Average Spend by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Payment method distribution (donut chart)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors_payment = plt.cm.Pastel1(np.linspace(0, 1, len(payment_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, 
                                    colors=colors_payment, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
                                    pctdistance=0.85, startangle=90)
centre_circle = plt.Circle((0, 0), 0.70, fc='white')
ax4.add_artist(centre_circle)
ax4.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in revenue comparison (grouped bar chart)
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
takeaway_data = df.groupby(['is_takeaway', 'product'])['total'].sum().unstack().fillna(0)
takeaway_data.index = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
takeaway_data.T.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, width=0.8)
ax5.set_xlabel('Product')
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax5.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Revenue by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend(title='Service Type')
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Hourly sales pattern (line chart)
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time']).dt.hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax6.plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=8)
ax6.fill_between(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, alpha=0.3)
ax6.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax6.set_title('Hourly Sales Pattern', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax6.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
